purpose: Name every claim a native node is allowed to make, and say what each claim rests on, so a guarantee cannot cite a model that does not exist or a measurement nobody took.
note: `Guarantee::Native` carries a `semantic_model` string and the validator asked only that it not be empty. The frontend now builds the string from a closed vocabulary, and this file records the same vocabulary along with the recording behind each entry. A model with evidence is one whose behaviour was measured across the shells and whose measurement a gate re-runs. A model without evidence is one whose meaning is the IR operation's own definition - a sequence runs its statements in order - where there is nothing to measure; that is a different claim from having measured nothing, which is why the field is present and null rather than absent. The interpreter's name is prefixed at use, so an entry here is a suffix.
